role: Read-only public-source contract extraction; not implementation, design acceptance or independent review

accepted_ui_equivalence.meaning: ui.c exact byte equivalence previously connector-verified; supporting motion/engine/SMC/clip files pinned here at3c41 only

write.entry: A writable R_ENG control is turned through turn_ref. Source updates its base through pref_set_impl first, then calls motion_touch.
write.eligibility: motion_touch returns unless R_ENG and seq.playing. ui.rec selects recording; stationary controls make no request. It has no independent capture-class mode.
write.destination: Current seq.ppat[engine_motion_part(target,voice)], that owning part, and the target/voice/id triple; not necessarily the selected visible part.
write.allocation: Find existing lane or allocate first unused pool slot. Allocation initializes every step to MOT_NONE, increments generation and publishes used last.
write.step_write: rec_req is a flag. On the next matching active-part step, capture the then-current base; several between-step moves coalesce into the latest base. That step is written; untouched steps retain their data.
write.interpolation: For a continuing gesture, d=(step-rec_last+pass)%pass. If2<=d<=4 and prior written value exists, fill the intervening positions with integer linear interpolation. Do not infer reverse/random interpolation beyond this exact source formula.
write.audible_owner: During recording gesture, applied=MOT_NONE and ramps are disabled, so the knob/base owns sound. After more than4 quiet matching-part steps the gesture ends and lane playback resumes.
write.full_pool: MOTION FULL is a1300ms source message. New lane allocation fails, but base editing happened earlier and is not rolled back by this failure.

live_override.entry: Playing, REC off, turn a writable R_ENG control that already has a lane. Base edits first, then hold_req is set. No existing lane means ordinary base edit only.
live_override.duration: Next matching-part step sets hold_left=pass and suppresses lane/ramp for pass matching active-part step events. A new turn renews the request. This is one part pass, not a fixed wall-clock interval.
live_override.persistent_consequence: Temporary suppression of lane playback does not make the base edit temporary. The new base remains and is used at MOT_NONE positions and when the lane releases.

playback_and_release.playback: Only active pattern lanes apply. Departing pattern lanes restore first and discard queued rec/hold requests. An explicit value applies at the step; a MOT_NONE step restores exact base when the restore callback exists.
playback_and_release.ramp: Ramp only when current and next positions are both explicit and unequal. motion_tick interpolates over the measured previous even/odd step length. No length yet means no first-step ramp.
playback_and_release.clock: Engine calls motion_tick only while motion is enabled, transport is playing and external clock is not waiting. A WAIT condition is not a completed motion write.
playback_and_release.stop_reset: motion_release restores eligible applied controls, cancels recording/hold/ramp history and resets measured step times; it does not delete saved lane data. Engine invokes it on playing→stopped, disabled motion, or motion reset.
playback_and_release.base: Original synth controls restore exact source base rather than a rounded display q. Performance bend/damper restore their live wheel state. Other targets restore source sound values; probability defaults100 and drum-velocity override defaults0/legacy accent.

whole_lane_clear.gesture: With no eligible held-step lock, hold physical BT and turn its current-page assigned K5–K8 control. K2/K3/K4 are not this clear gesture.
whole_lane_clear.priority: Held-step lock handling comes first; synth held-step locking is disabled while REC is on. SEQ held-note editing also comes before BT lane clear.
whole_lane_clear.effect: If lane exists, engine_motion_clear marks unused, cancels queued requests/ramp and queues eligible base restore; UI restores base, marks dirty and says MOTION CLEARED: <parameter>. No lane says NO MOTION ON <parameter>.
whole_lane_clear.release: BT is marked used before the clear attempt, including no-lane outcome. Its release cannot trigger the ordinary tap-to-save action.

single_step_clear.gesture: In PART, hold an eligible step, hold BT and turn its assigned K5–K8 parameter.
single_step_clear.scope: Only that lane position becomes MOT_NONE; other positions stay. If no explicit positions remain, free the lane. If no lane or no position existed, stop without deleting anything else.
single_step_clear.preview: Stopped lock edit previews through engine_set until release; stopped clear restores base. UI lock scope suppresses motion even when held step has no lock. Release returns to base or currently applied motion as appropriate.

lcd_and_lights.readout_priority: Held lock if present; otherwise held base with motion suppressed. Without eligible held step, show applied motion when value>=0, otherwise base.
lcd_and_lights.ordinary_strip: Held lock: amber dot; held eligible control without lock: line-colored dot. Existing motion lane: white dot while applied, dim dot when no value is being applied. Value follows the same priority.
lcd_and_lights.part_matrix: Existing2x2 mark when locked or, without held scope, when motion lane exists; the matrix does not prove a separate live-override caption. Drum/303/BREAK sequence views retain source lock/value notches.
lcd_and_lights.rec_led: SEQ REC logical LED follows ui.rec. PLAY is beat indication while running or slow WAIT indication. No dedicated motion-write/override lamp was found in the examined path.
lcd_and_lights.bt_led: Existing SAVE state indicates queued/failed/unsaved according to source blink rules; clearing marks project dirty. Do not invent a new successful-flash result from it.

keyboard.gesture: Physical FX + physical SEQ, in either order; fire when the second member becomes held. These are not SEQ PLAY or SEQ REC.
keyboard.priority: input calls keyboard_panic before normal button dispatch and consumes chord member edges through final release. Normal FX/SEQ navigation occurs on unconsumed release; successful chord does not navigate those pages.
keyboard.rearm: Fires once per chord. Both members must be released before another fire. Unrelated held controls are ignored. Controls held across project transfer are inhibited until all chord members release.
keyboard.feedback: This keyboard source route does not call say(), change view, toggle REC/PLAY, or define a dedicated panic LED. Existing view/transport LEDs remain source-controlled.

retired_scope.sequencer: Cancel active note recorder ownership, clear fill_on and release sequencer bass/BREAK owners. seq_notes_off explicitly does not stop, rewind or send MIDI Stop.
retired_scope.engine: At the audio boundary release both original synth runtimes and local-key ownership, clear held note counts, MIDI/BREAK ownership and held slices, and call drum909_all_off/drum808_all_off. Request clip-key notes-off on SMK.
retired_scope.queue: Capture command/MIDI cutoffs; retire live key generations immediately. Old queued drum/bass/record/off/BREAK events before cutoff are discarded, fresh admitted onsets survive. Queued control commands still execute.
retired_scope.preserved: No project pattern/sound/lane delete, transport stop/rewind, REC toggle or effects-tail reset appears in the inspected panic route. Running sequence may generate later notes. It is not an unconditional global-silence or external-device-reset promise.
retired_scope.fresh_recovery: After releasing the chord, a new legitimate note acquires fresh ownership. Existing generation/context maximum explicitly blocks an owner rather than wrapping; source safety and musical recovery execution remain untested here.

smc.gesture: Same physical SMC peer BANK L(0x2E)+BANK R(0x2F), explicit DAW mode only. Channel arrows are not members. Two peers cannot jointly form a chord.
smc.single_tap: A DAW bank press waits for its real release before normal bank navigation, so first-member navigation cannot escape ahead of a chord. No timer threshold is used.
smc.contexts: User mode/raw User NoteOn and MMC are ineligible; mode changes inhibit an already-held member until all release. Blocked restoration/test routing still processes bank releases to retire ownership.
smc.effect: Eligible chord calls the same engine_request_notes_off. It is not Loopy stop or a full MIDI device reset.

clip_keys.gesture: In active clip-key context, press and release NOTE REPEAT alone. It fires on release only if it was not used with ARP for LATCH.
clip_keys.effect: ck_all_off drains queued human notes, sends key note-offs, stops the current arp note and clears the arp/live-note list. Then send MIDI CC123 value0 on the configured clip-key channel and display PANIC.
clip_keys.limits: This is the clip-key MIDI route; it is not the normal NOTE REPEAT→MIX tap and does not establish Loopy transport stop, FX-tail kill or external device response.

undo_recovery.gesture: Normal local context PATCH+SEQ REC undoes; PATCH+SEQ PLAY redoes. Clip history/transport interceptors run before normal local transport handling and retain their own scope.
undo_recovery.grouping: Undo normally groups edits between400ms quiet moments or a recording pass. do_undo first finishes note recorder ownership and commits the current snapshot. Motion changes set undo_lanes and request engine_motion_reset, releasing old applied motion.
undo_recovery.limits: Tagged-sound/CP1 admission and pending outcomes remain with incumbent; this extraction does not resolve them. No persistence round trip or audible recovery was executed.

five_part_copy.entry: Normal non-clip routing: hold BT; choose destination white key/pad mapped to one of16 pattern positions in current bank. BT+OCTAVE− selects patterns1–16; BT+OCTAVE+ selects17–32.
five_part_copy.invitation: After BT alone250ms, with no keys/other buttons/turn after press and no question, show CHOOSE PASTE TARGET. No source snapshot exists at this stage; releasing an otherwise unused BT still follows tap-save.
five_part_copy.source_capture: At destination key-down, first mark BT used. If all five current seq.ppat equal destination, return with no copy. Otherwise store the five current sounding/adopted seq.ppat IDs in ui.paste_src; queued pcue targets are not selected. The tuple is stable through confirmation, not an early raw-byte snapshot.
five_part_copy.occupied: pattern_used tests musical drum hits, synth gates/ties and BREAK steps. Used destination asks PASTE OVER Pn? / IT HAS NOTES. SCALE confirms; PATCH restores caller and says CANCELLED. SEQ PLAY cancels normal question then performs transport start/stop; clip exception retains its separate interceptor.
five_part_copy.empty: No occupied-note question: run ACT_COPY immediately. Motion-only destination data does not itself satisfy pattern_used, so owned destination lanes may still be replaced without an occupied-note question.
five_part_copy.copied: Loop canonical parts0..4:909,808,synthA,synthB,BREAK. For each differing source/destination, clone its complete part structure and all used source-owned lanes.909 also brings the source pattern swing. Global project sound/FX settings are not copied by this function.
five_part_copy.capacity: Each part preflights all required source lanes against unused pool slots plus that destination part lanes. If insufficient, that part remains unchanged. Successful parts clear/rebuild destination-owned lanes. The overall five-part loop is sequential, not transactional; earlier/later parts can succeed while another fails.
five_part_copy.result: Success says PARTS PASTED TO Pn; any part failure says MOTION FULL: NOT ALL PASTED. ACT_COPY finishes active note recorder ownership first and marks dirty. The used BT release does not issue an extra save.
five_part_copy.playback: Copy does not cue or select destination and does not switch seq.ppat. Hearing the copy needs the existing separate pattern-selection gesture and its stopped/running adoption policy.

count_convention: Button presses and knob detents counted separately; releases shown explicitly and page/part navigation setup excluded. Counts are source-derived, not timed or executed. Automatic audio/step/confirmation boundaries are not extra presses.

action_counts.prerequisite: Target/page known; playing, REC on, clock supplies a next step; writable R_ENG
action_counts.automatic_boundary: Next matching active-part step captures latest base; no stationary write

action_counts.prerequisite: Target/page known; stopped, REC off; normal local context
action_counts.automatic_boundary: SEQ REC press + SEQ PLAY press +turn; broader current REC semantics remain, no new capture class

action_counts.prerequisite: Playing, REC off, known parameter with existing lane
action_counts.automatic_boundary: Hold starts next matching step; resumes after pass matching steps; base edit persists

action_counts.prerequisite: Known K5–K8 target; no eligible held step; existing lane
action_counts.automatic_boundary: BT held+turn; used BT release has no save

action_counts.prerequisite: Known PART page; eligible existing step; no step held initially
action_counts.automatic_boundary: Step down+BT down+turn; leaves other step values

action_counts.prerequisite: Both FX/SEQ initially released, eligible local input
action_counts.automatic_boundary: Fire second member press; both releases rearm; playback may continue

action_counts.prerequisite: Same admitted peer, DAW mode, both BANK members released
action_counts.automatic_boundary: Fire second member press; both releases rearm

action_counts.prerequisite: Active clip-key context; NOTE REPEAT unused with ARP
Bank already selected; target not pattern_used; not all_on target; no modal/clip owner
action_counts.automatic_boundary: BT down+destination down; source tuple captured at target press
BT down+destination down+SCALE tap; confirm runs on SCALE release
BT down+destination down+PATCH tap; no copy

action_counts.prerequisite: BT already held; target bank differs
action_counts.automatic_boundary: One OCTAVE− or+ tap; then destination

action_counts.prerequisite: Normal local context; available admitted history; PATCH+SEQ REC or PATCH+SEQ PLAY
action_counts.automatic_boundary: Transport/history member acts on press; tagged sound admission not resolved here

not_run: Emulator, browser interaction or audio playback
CP1 pending-sound/Keep cases or producer takeover
Candidate, runtime, Settings or shared plan edits
